name: EmberSign
subtitle: On-device signing and tweak injection
description: Development releases of EmberSign for iOS.

apps.name: EmberSign
apps.subtitle: Apple Accounts, IPA signing and JIT tools
apps.localizedDescription: EmberSign signs IPAs using imported certificates or Apple Account provisioning, supports multiple saved Apple Accounts, compatible tweak injection, pairing-file management, JIT preparation, paired-device app inventory, best-effort app refresh, experimental Apple Watch installation, tracked Watch re-signing and GitHub update downloads, and error diagnostics with online lookup. Apple Watch installation and background refresh require real-device testing and an active pairing tunnel.

versions.localizedDescription: EmberSign 0.2.1 build 97. Changes: Update and re-sign Watch companions directly from Sources and Apps; Show Watch preparation errors and retry guidance in Apps and Sources.

EmberSign 0.2.1 build 95. Changes: Provision WatchLink probe App Group and verify signed entitlements; Snapshot existing WatchLink group memberships after obtaining a certificate; Disambiguate Developer Portal AppGroup from EmberSign widget storage; Restore compatible Xcode dependency caches for signing-flow builds.
EmberSign 0.2.1 build 91. Changes: Update Apple Watch apps from their repo automatically; Install and update Apple Watch apps straight from Sources repos.
EmberSign 0.2.1 build 89. Changes: Seal nested Watch bundles after writing their provisioning profile.
EmberSign 0.2.1 build 88. Changes: Keep embedded profiles when signing the Apple Watch and extensions.
EmberSign 0.2.1 build 87. Changes: Fix "Missing Pairing (-7001)" on local installs when LocalDevVPN is not 10.7.0.1.
EmberSign 0.2.1 build 86. Changes: Fix Watch signing crash: Zsign called a nil completion block.
EmberSign 0.2.1 build 85. Changes: Fix Apple session expiry (1100), native Watch crash, and opaque install errors.
EmberSign 0.2.1 build 84. Changes: Enforce pseudonymous author metadata and owner privacy; Remove owner personal-name attribution.
EmberSign 0.2.1 build 82. Changes: Enforce visible installed version/build across app releases.
EmberSign 0.2.1 build 81. Changes: Show actual installed app version and build in UI.
EmberSign 0.2.1 build 79. Changes: Name release IPA with build number and add changelog to release notes.

EmberSign 0.2.1 build 78: Apple Accounts, signing and provisioning, paired-device app inventory, quota estimates, refresh controls, JIT tools, experimental Watch installation and refresh, GitHub Watch updates, and diagnostics.
